Coverage is high overall (96.56% statements/lines, 98.42% functions, 86.37% branches) and meets configured global thresholds, reducing broad untested-surface risk.

Branch coverage is notably lower in several core paths (e.g., `src/index.ts` at 36.66% branches, `src/rules/require-traceability.ts` at 44.44%, and multiple helpers in the ~50–70% range), leaving conditional logic less exercised than line/function coverage suggests.

Traceability metadata is prevalent (90 @supports annotations in test comments) but one suite lacks any @supports (`tests/maintenance/storyParser.test.ts`), leaving a small mapping gap.

Given strong execution and coverage with localized branch gaps and a minor traceability annotation omission, a mid‑80s score reflects a healthy suite with moderate residual risk in conditional paths and mapping completeness.
